name: Files
description: Browse, search, read, copy, move, rename and delete files inside the folders you trust. Deleted files go to a Nexora trash and can be restored.

settings.label: Trusted folders
settings.description: Files can only see and change things inside these folders.

settings.label: Max text read (KB)
settings.description: readText returns at most this much of a file per call.

settings.label: Include hidden files
settings.description: List and search dotfiles such as .env or .git.

settings.label: Keep trash for (days)
settings.description: Deleted and overwritten files are kept this long so they can be restored, then deleted for good. 0 keeps them until you empty the trash.

settings.label: Max trash size (MB)
settings.description: When the trash grows past this, the oldest items are deleted for good, never the most recent one. 0 for no limit.
